limitations: Candidate: public build baad0bc (rc6), a sanitized export of SpaceApp release/1.1.7-rc6 3e4572bc97 (rc5 c067c535c2 plus ip-address 10.7.4) with the overlay fix that pins npm's bundled ip-address to 10.7.4 in the images. The rc5 release run 39937429712 stopped at its own security gates (ip-address 10.7.1 CVE-2026-111997 in the source tree and all six images) before publishing anything.

Tested artifacts: launcher run-spaceapp-1.1.7.tgz sha256 b3dec1aa3630d6a2273e8300ab7cf5347d2e45d05daf5f5db8e48955614fd9fb (byte-identical to rc3's and rc5's); images by ID from the archive images-1.1.7.tar.gz sha256 7b19cf7f327b84c886f965fe9910ce758e37c78485fdada4471f05b0ebb3947a: core sha256:e65954f0cd645b82a9493f3ca43d5aae1f0cb76faceec23827e5c0ab15ad0549, cli sha256:b2d2f6eaee1c679b438ac4c76957e1a67008a205e17793d1f587b2992ec06849, browser sha256:791f2d7766c9eaef6565fc6777c60b5ff97e17447db80b54650107c5cc8e2736. The release workflow rebuilds the images from this source (IR117-C-F7).

Executed on rc6: linux fresh-install; windows fresh-install; macos fresh-install (planned but carried from rc5 with the rc6 failure attached: linux/first-agent). Every other proof is carried from rc5's acceptance (carriedFrom "rc5 c067c535c2", reason: rc6 changes only ip-address 10.7.1->10.7.4 (app lockfile and npm's bundled copy in the images); launcher tgz byte-identical (b3dec1aa)); proofs rc5 had carried from rc3 keep carriedFrom "rc3 060d85a" with carriedVia "rc5 c067c535c2". The release check does not show carriedFrom; carriedProofs and README.md list every one.
VM hosts are x86_64. ARM64 container validation remains a release workflow gate.
Fresh installer timings use preloaded local candidate images; they exclude network image downloads.
Windows desktop commands ran as interactive scheduled tasks in an owned RDP session; this is not keystroke coverage of every wizard prompt.

No known exceptions: every first-agent check ran on OpenCode 2 with an OpenCode Zen free model from the lab's own address and completed with real tool calls and no permission prompt. The Zen exception code in scripts/release-evidence.mjs is unused.

Known issue, accepted for 1.1.7 (Nous 2026-10-21 on report 4713, fixed in 1.1.8): after a failed restore every database and file is put back, but SpaceApp is left stopped and the launcher prints no hint; `spaceapp up` brings it back with its own data (restore-left-stopped, VM218 rc3 supplementary).

rc3's supplementary proofs (doctor fault/fix, telemetry Yes/No, update badge, upgrade from 1.1.5, the VM219 launcher tests, Claude Code install and backup/restore with Temporal, licences in the images, OpenCode after a CLI restart, restore rollback) ran on rc3 060d85a and are recorded in the rc3 acceptance; they are not repeated on rc5 and not counted here.
The public suite's SQLite worker tests need Python 3.12 or newer; the spaceapp-core image has no python3, so the SQLite Databases worker cannot run in public installations (1.1.7).

Open limitations recorded in docs/quality/KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md: cross-version restore after a release that adds referencing tables (IR117-C-F6) and evidence bound to the source rather than the shipped image bytes (IR117-C-F7).
npm next publication, environment approval and latest promotion have not yet completed.
